name: object-slot-250-writer
description: From the title screen, press Space and immediately poke a sentinel into the low word of object pointer-table slot 250 ($035AEA), then break on the next write while the title-to-world unpack runs. Slot 250-255 are the only object-table entries that differ between the pinned first-world capture and the live Vesta/Gaea/Dion workspaces, so this names the code that fills them (#280).
